label: input y at late original positions (t >= 5)
explanation: Fires when the input token is the letter y during the original (pre-<DEL>) phase at positions 5-8; y accounts for 99.8% of activation mass. It is silent on y at positions 0-4, at the delimiter, and throughout the copy phase (including when y is fed back or output). Magnitude increases with position and with closeness to <DEL>: weak at t=5 (11% of mass), strongest when y is the final original token (to_go=0 holds 52% of mass; all top examples are y as the 9th token in L=9 sequences). Most false positives are y at t=5, where activation is near threshold. The rare misses are tiny activations on other letters (mostly r) at t=8.

issues: Factual claims hold on the dev profile. The feature is active only in phase 0, with 0 activations at the delimiter or in the copy phase. It never fires at t=0-4 or t>=9. y carries 99.8% of the activation mass and r carries 0.2%. to_go=0 holds 51.6% of the mass. Mass by t: 5 = 10.9%, 6 = 34.2%, 7 = 35.1%, 8 = 19.7%.

All false positives sit at t=5. y at t=5 has precision 0.81 and only 10.9% of the mass. y at t>=6 has precision 1.00. Splitting the t=5 cases by history did not give a clean separator. Precision ranged from 0.75 to 0.91 when split by: to_go (0.81 either way), whether a digit was seen earlier (0.86 vs 0.75), an earlier y (0.91), a vowel or digit as the previous token (0.83-0.86), or vowels seen. This looks like activation near threshold, not a missing condition.

Test misses: 499 steps holding 0.2% of the mass. They are tiny activations (0.01-0.05 of max) at t=8 on various tokens, mostly r. r at t=8 alone scores precision 0.10 and mass recall 0.0016, so it is scattered noise.

Small overclaim: 'magnitude grows with closeness to <DEL>' is confounded with t, since to_go and t are tied by L. The mass share actually falls at t=8 (19.7%) compared with t=7 (35.1%). That is partly because there are fewer L=9 sequences, but 'grows with position' is not strictly monotone in mass share. Per-step firing rate at orig_idx does rise monotonically, 0.027 to 0.038.
Test scores confirm the reported ones: precision 0.922, recall 0.981, F1 0.951, mass recall 0.998.
